messages.subject: how I can get the beginning and end-positions an of QTL with CIM method
parts:
Dear professor Karl Broman 
I would like to have your suggestions about how I can get the beginning and end positions of a QTL with CIM method because I found only the option scan 1 to find the positions of peaks and borders of QTLs for SIM method, how it can be calculated for CIM with R/qtl?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] how I can get the beginning and end-positions an of QTL with CIM method
parts:
You can use lodint() and bayesint() to get LOD support intervsls and approximate Bayes credible intervals, respectively.

karl
